t: Ultra-strong cloth wipes are ideal for removing oil, grease, ink, paint, silicones and uncured PU foam. Features a powerful cleaning agent, and abrasive side for effective scrubbing of stubborn dirt and grime. Wipes remain wet and usable for over an hour and don’t dry out when the lid is left open. One wipe dispenses at a time.
b: For Medium to Heavy Duty Work
